nodes.title: How to swap crypto
nodes.subtitle: Choose from thousands of tokens to easily swap with.

image.title: How to swap crypto
image.description: How to swap crypto with MetaMask

childMarkdownRemark.html:
Swapping crypto is fast, easy, and secure with MetaMask. You can choose from thousands of your favorite tokens across nine networks including Ethereum, Linea, Base, and Arbitrum. MetaMask Swaps also include gas fees right in your quotes, making swapping crypto as smooth as can be.

We've simplified cross-chain swapping too. Send&Swap lets you choose the token you want to spend and the token you want the other person to receive — all in one move. As ever, safety is essential when it comes to your digital assets. So rest easy. MetaMask Swaps are powered by our razor-tight, industry-leading security.

Below, you'll find step-by-step guides showing you how to swap crypto with MetaMask.

Let’s get into it! 🦊

How to swap crypto with MetaMask Extension

  1. Open the MetaMask browser extension.
  2. Select the network you want to swap on, and click the Swap button.
  3. Select the token you want to swap from. Example: ETH.
  4. Enter the amount that you want to swap.
  5. Select the token you want to swap to. Example: DAI.
  6. A preferred quote will be loaded automatically. To select a different quote, click View all quotes.
  7. Click Swap to confirm.

Success! 🦊

How to swap crypto with MetaMask App

  1. Sign-in to your MetaMask mobile app.
  2. Select the network you want to swap on, located at the top of your screen. Example: Ethereum Mainnet.
  3. Tap the menu button, which has two arrows in opposite directions and is located on the bottom of your homepage screen.
  4. Tap Swap.
  5. Select the token you want to swap from by tapping the token name that appears under your wallet address. Example: ETH.
  6. Enter the amount that you want to swap.
  7. Select the token you want to swap to. Example: DAI.
  8. Tap Get quotes to proceed. Note: you can manually select a different quote from our range of industry-leading providers.
  9. Tap Swap to confirm.

Success! 🦊

How to swap crypto with MetaMask Portfolio

  1. Connect your MetaMask wallet to portfolio.metamask.io
  2. Click Move crypto.
  3. Click Swap.
  4. Select the network you want to swap from in the dropdown menu. Example: Ethereum.
  5. Select the token you want to swap from. Example: ETH.
  6. Enter the amount that you want to swap.
  7. Select the token you want to swap to. Example: DAI.
  8. Click Get Quotes to proceed. Note: you can manually select a different quote from our range of industry-leading providers.
  9. Click Swap to confirm.

Success! 🦊

Ready to start swapping crypto? If you’re on desktop, download MetaMask Extension. If you’re on mobile, download MetaMask app for iOS or Android.

Need more help? We got you. Check out our MetaMask Support guide about swapping crypto.

nodes.title: MetaMaskで仮想通貨を売却して現金化する方法
nodes.subtitle: MetaMask Portfolioの売却機能を使用すると、審査済みのプロバイダーを通じて数回のクリックで仮想通貨を売却し、現金化できます。

childMarkdownRemark.html:
MetaMask Portfolioの売却機能を使用すると、暗号資産を法定通貨 (USD、EUR、GBP) で簡単に出金できます。 購入機能と組み合わせることで、自己完結型のweb3エクスペリエンスが完成します。必要な仲介サービスが減り、銀行口座やPayPal など対応している送金先を指定して、より短時間で法定通貨を直接受け取れます。


審査済みの仮想通貨プロバイダー


MetaMaskは1社のプロバイダーに限ることなく、何社もの審査済みのプロバイダーをご用意しています。その多くは購入フローと同じプロバイダーで、当社の高い基準を満たしており、イーサリアムメインネットのETHをご希望の対応法定通貨にリアルタイムで変換できるよう、さまざまなオプションを提供しています。

世界中が対象


売却機能は現在米国 (州による制限が適用されます)、英国、ヨーロッパの一部でご利用いただけますが、世界中のコミュニティでご利用いただけるよう今後他の地域に拡大される予定です。 ユーザーが仮想通貨の世界に自由に出入りできる手段を提供することが重要であり、これらのオプションにより、さらに多くの人々がweb3を手軽に利用できるようになることを願っております。 まずはイーサリアムメインネットのETHのサポートから開始し、間もなくレイヤー2ネットワークのネイティブガストークンと、USD、EUR、GBPの法定通貨に拡張される予定です。

MetaMask Portfolioで仮想通貨売却機能を使用する方法


仮想通貨を売って現金化する方法

  1. MetaMaskウォレットを「portfolio.metamask.io」に接続します。
  2. 「売却」タブをクリックして開始します。
  3. 地域を選択します。
  4. 売却する仮想通貨トークンとネットワークを選択します (例: イーサリアムのETH)。
  5. お住まいの地域で利用可能な法定通貨の口座を選択します (銀行口座、PayPalなど)。
  6. 売却する仮想通貨の数量を入力します (例: 0.5 ETH)。
  7. 利用可能なさまざまなプロバイダーのクォートがすべてリアルタイムで表示されます。 1つ選択して続行します。
  8. プロバイダーのWebサイトにリダイレクトされるので、法定通貨の口座に登録してリンクさせます。その後は、自動的にMetaMask Portfolioに戻ります。
  9. 「ETHを[Provider]に送金」を選択し、ウォレットから法定通貨の口座に仮想通貨を送金します。
  10. MetaMaskウォレットでトランザクションを確定させます。
  11. 「売却」タブで注文の処理状況を確認できます。 所要時間はプロバイダーによって異なり、資金が法定通貨の口座に反映されるまで数日かかる場合があります。

以上で、現金化は完了です！ 🦊

プロバイダーを整理


MetaMask Portfolioの購入および売却機能を使うと、仮想通貨と法定通貨の双方向の取引が可能で、プロバイダーの多くは購入と売却で共通です。 そのため、特定のプロバイダー1社で登録と銀行口座のリンクを一度行うだけで済みます。 ぜひ、これらの機能をご活用いただけることを願っております。

始める準備はいいですか？ 詳細は、metamask.io/portfolio/をご覧ください。

MetaMask Portfolio: web3のすべてを把握して管理

MetaMask Portfolioは、包括的かつユーザーフレンドリーなプラットフォームを提供し、ユーザーのweb3のニーズを満たすと同時に、思い通りのコントロールを可能にします。 ダッシュボード、購入、スワップ、ブリッジ、ステーキングなど、あらゆる機能が揃っています。 当社は常に有意義なアップデートを通じて、DAppの改善と進化に取り組んでいます。 こちらをクリックして、MetaMask Portfolioとその機能の詳細をご覧ください。

nodes.title: How to buy crypto
nodes.subtitle: Learn how to go from cash to crypto.

image.title: How to buy crypto
image.description: How to buy crypto with MetaMask

childMarkdownRemark.html:
Wondering how to buy crypto, but not sure where to start? You’ve come to the right place. Buying crypto with MetaMask is speedy, simple, and safe.

You can buy crypto straight into MetaMask using payment methods like a credit card, debit card, bank account, Apple Pay, Google Pay, or PayPal. No need for centralized exchanges. Select from thousands of your favorite tokens on over 15 networks including Ethereum, Linea, Base, and more. The choice is yours.

We're driven by making the process of buying crypto quick and cost-effective. So we've cut out all of the unnecessary steps – saving you time, and money on excess fees too.

We also know that safety is essential when it comes to your digital assets. MetaMask is the most secure crypto wallet for good reason. Our security is industry-leading and razor-tight, so you can buy (and sell, swap, stake, and bridge) with peace of mind. And if you need help along the way, our 24/7 support team is always here to assist around-the-clock.

Below, you'll find videos and step-by-step guides showing you how to buy crypto with MetaMask on your browser or mobile app.

Let's get into it! 🦊

How to buy crypto with MetaMask Extension

Clicking the Buy & Sell button on the MetaMask extension will redirect you to MetaMask Portfolio. Once there, connect your MetaMask wallet.

  1. Click Move crypto.
  2. Click Buy.
  3. Select your region, and currency — located to the right of your wallet address.
  4. Select the crypto token, and network that you want to buy on. Example: ETH on Ethereum.
  5. Enter the amount you want to buy. Example: 0.5 ETH Example: $100 of ETH.
  6. Select the payment method you want to use to buy crypto. Example: debit card, credit card, bank account, or PayPal balance. Availability will depend on your region.
  7. Select the best real-time quote from our industry-leading providers.
  8. You'll be securely redirected to the provider's website to complete the purchase, and funds will be deposited into your MetaMask wallet.

Success! 🦊

How to buy crypto with MetaMask app

  1. Sign-in to your MetaMask app.
  2. Tap the menu button, which has two arrows in opposite directions and is located on the bottom of your homepage screen.
  3. Tap Buy.
  4. Select your region and currency — located to the right of your wallet address.
  5. Select the crypto token, and network that you want to buy on. Example: ETH on Ethereum.
  6. Enter the amount you want to buy. Example: 0.5 ETH.
  7. Select the payment method you want to use to buy crypto. Example: debit card, credit card, bank account, or PayPal balance. Availability will depend on your region.
  8. Tap Get quotes to proceed. Select the best quote from our industry-leading providers.
  9. Complete the transaction on the provider’s portal, and link your desired payment method.
  10. Review the order summary in your MetaMask app, and confirm the transaction to get crypto in your wallet.

Success! 🦊

Ready to get started? If you’re on desktop, download MetaMask Extension. If you’re on mobile, download MetaMask app for iOS or Android.

Need more help? We got you. Check out our MetaMask Support guide about buying crypto

nodes.title: Mercuryo x MetaMask: global crypto adoption through local solutions
nodes.subtitle: Meet the builders who are transforming web3, in our More With MetaMask Partner Series.

image.title: Mercuryo x MetaMask
image.description: Mercuryo and MetaMask are enabling mass crypto adoption through local solutions.

childMarkdownRemark.html:
MetaMask is the gateway to the decentralized web, enabling you to do more. Users can connect to any dapp, on any network, from any device. From DeFi to DeSci, gaming to NFTs, and beyond: MetaMask is passionate about the web3 community. Our More With MetaMask Partner Series shines a light on builders who are innovating across the ecosystem. Next up, Mercuryo.

For non-crypto natives, buying crypto can feel intimidating. But with Mercuryo’s MetaMask integration, you can covert fiat into crypto in as little as 15 seconds directly within your wallet — no unnecessary steps, or complicated processes needed. Here’s how Mercuryo makes that happen in different parts of the world.

Localized fiat-to-crypto solutions in Brazil

Did you know that Pix, Brazil’s instant payment system, has over 152 million registered users, processing daily transactions worth approximately $10 billion? It’s a prime example of how localized solutions can drive crypto adoption by making digital payments faster and more accessible.

For users in emerging markets like Brazil, alternative payment methods such as Pix are often favored over traditional credit cards. In a recent survey, 97% of respondents identified Pix as their preferred payment method for e-commerce, far outpacing credit cards and other alternatives. Pix’s instant processing, zero fees, and ability to complete payments in under 2.5 seconds have made it an obvious choice. The familiarity and trust associated with such systems reduce friction, encouraging more users to onboard into the crypto ecosystem.

Mercuryo understands the importance of tapping into preferred payment methods to enhance the user experience. Partnering with MetaMask, Mercuryo has integrated localized solutions like Pix, catering to convenience, speed, and familiarity. This approach boosts conversion rates, making it easier for people to access crypto in ways they already trust and use daily. Brazilian users can seamlessly convert their fiat into crypto using Pix, making onboarding faster and more reliable than traditional bank transfers.

All you need to do is select Pix as your payment method when purchasing crypto within MetaMask. The process is nearly instantaneous, with funds being transferred into your account within minutes. This ease of use is crucial in a market where quick payments and low fees are highly valued.

Harnessing regional payment methods in Indonesia

Mercuryo's integration expands beyond Europe, the US, and Latin America, bringing localized solutions to Asia. In Indonesia, where mobile use is high and access to traditional banking services can be limited, Mercuryo works with a range of local Alternative payment methods (APMs) that help bridge the gap between fiat and crypto.

Indonesian users can now easily access crypto via platforms like: QRIS — a national standard for QR code payments, OVO — a leading mobile wallet and digital payment platform, BR — a state-owned bank, and BNI — another major Indonesian bank.

Indonesia has witnessed a dramatic surge in cryptocurrency interest. The value of crypto transactions reached 158.84 trillion IDR (approximately $9.76 billion) in Q1 2024, reflecting the growing acceptance and use of crypto in daily transactions.

According to the 2023 Chainalysis Global Crypto Adoption Index, Indonesia ranks seventh globally in crypto adoption—outpacing countries like China and the UK. It also holds the fourth spot in global crypto transaction volume within South Asia, Southeast Asia, and Oceania (CSAO).

This growth is driven by crypto’s role as a hedge against inflation and currency fluctuations, alongside its increasing use for online purchases, remittances, and as an investment. As mobile wallet adoption grows, crypto is becoming more mainstream.

Tapping into Single Euro Payments Area integration in the EU

Europe’s Single Euro Payments Area (SEPA) system provides a seamless and cost-effective method for bank transfers across the Eurozone. Initially launched in 2008 for credit transfers, SEPA rolled out direct debit functionality in 2009. Today, SEPA functions across 36 countries including all European Union (EU) nations, as well as Switzerland, Iceland, Norway, Andorra, Liechtenstein, Monaco, San Marino, and Vatican City.

Thanks to Mercuryo and MetaMask’s SEPA integration, European users have a familiar and secure way to deposit funds into their crypto wallets, without the delays and fees associated with traditional payment methods. Through SEPA, users can enable direct bank transfers into their MetaMask wallet. The smooth integration of SEPA within MetaMask has increased crypto adoption and user satisfaction by significantly reducing the barriers to entry.

Mercuryo and MetaMask: enabling mass crypto adoption

Mercuryo and MetaMask’s partnership illuminates the importance of providing tailored, local solutions for the global crypto community. By focusing on region-specific APMs, like PIX in Brazil, SEPA in Europe, and QRIS in Indonesia, Mercuryo ensures that users from diverse markets can easily access and navigate the world of cryptocurrency.

The powerful integration of local payment methods within MetaMask simplifies the fiat-to-crypto process, making it easier than ever for anyone to get started with crypto.

Ready to buy crypto? Try Mercuryo’s on-ramp in MetaMask today to see how easy it is to start buying cryptocurrencies with your local payment method.
